Key renames: - Presto: padj → pval_adj, logFC → log2FC - BPCells: foreground → group, p_val_raw → pval, foreground_mean → avgExpr; pval_adj added via BH - AnnData: names → feature, logfoldchanges → log2FC, pvals → pval, pvals_adj → pval_adj - edgeR: logCPM → avgExpr, logFC → log2FC, PValue → pval, FDR → pval_adj Final sort: group, pval_adj, desc(abs(log2FC)) (multicontrast: contrast, pval_adj, desc(abs(log2FC))).
